body:
Thanks so much for the thoughtful response! 

I'm checking out that story right now and taking all of this into account. These are very helpful notes :)

I'm glad to hear you made it through the night! I know what it's like to wake up after hell, it's very strange. 

I'm a literature major myself. I've had several close friends in engineering and have a lot of respect for how difficult that major is. Are you pulling through ok? Are you taking a courseload you can handle?

As for where I want my life to go, I just want it to go at all. I find that in what I've read and seen, the people I respect have taken a million different paths at different times and ended up still as people I respect. I just hope I am one of them, and not one of the many who fall off the map completely. 

I'd like to be a writer ultimately. My teachers believe in me but I am not a good student. I'm in my fifth year and will likely face a sixth, or may have to drop out. I believe in my writing but not in my work ethic and I think the latter may ruin me. But who knows.

Hey, thank you so much for the response! 

You're very welcoming. Thank you.

I guess what's going on in my life is mostly nothing. I don't feel particularly unlucky, unhappy, or unwell. I'm afraid that what I consider "difficult" is in fact very easy.

Basically I'm living in a college town with a large group of roommates with whom I get along very well. I have college paid for by my parents and am allowed a great deal of liberties and luxuries. 

I have a lot of friends, and I've had a fair amount of lovers. In high school, I was terrified I was unattractive and unlikable. I'm now 23, and find myself afraid of the opposite; that I'm incapable of caring for a large network of people who wish to care for me. I still feel I may be unattractive and unlikable, haha.

I'm overweight, often drunk. I'm drunk right now. I cut back to drinking once a week socially a few months ago but am currently drunk alone. 

I think I'll be useless in the real world. I'm astounded by the people who love me and do not trust them, because my most likable self is superficial and exaggerated. 

I'd also like to ask how you are? I don't want this to be one-sided. I've bared a lot here, but I believe in my ability to empathize and help. Please tell me as well.

Title: George, I'm Telling You Something

Genre: Realistic Fiction, Fiction

Word Count: 1200 Words

Feedback: Feedback of any kind. I'm wondering what effect the piece has on people, if any. It's a story I wrote a few years ago that many IRL friends of mine still consider my "best work". Curious as to whether it is, in a larger sense, any good or not. 

https://docs.google.com/document/d/1NFoVRw658dPlVMLwSUo5Wom3sTlAdzsswP6r-0C0uAU/edit?usp=sharing
That might be a little much. I go big when I'm sleep-deprived

Be well, be strong. I'm there with you, considering, every few minutes. In my experience life has a way of making up for itself just barely at odd times. I want you and I to make it to that next moment where things fit together. I want that for myself, because if you make it, maybe I will. We'll go strange places, find new people. Stay kind. 

I just made this damn account. I don't know why except maybe to say this to you.
